about_the_game: The Chained Echoes: Ashes of Elrant (Original Game Soundtrack) is the official soundtrack to the Ashes of Elrant DLC for the critically acclaimed 16-bit RPG Chained Echoes. To accompany this new tale told by the masterful storyteller Matthias Linda, Eddie Marianukroh returns once again to provide the musical score. Presenting sixteen new songs with wonderful performances by various talented musicians, this soundtrack explores a new soundscape that will be a refreshing take to the world of Eldrea.
